note: Router keeps one model in memory (--models-max 1). Requesting a different teacher unloads the current one. Teachers are advisory: everything they produce is EXPERIMENTAL until verified.

Qwen3.8-27B.notes: Strongest model on the server; partial GPU offload (24 layers), rest in RAM.

OxCoder-9B.role: fast code teacher + fallback core-evolution mentor

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.role: multilingual + code teacher (mixture of experts: 35 B parameters, about 3 B active per token)
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.notes: Unsloth Q4_K_M, Apache-2.0. Stays off until it passes evo.learning.teacher_check (python -m evo.learning.teacher_check --name Qwen3.6-35B-A3B --enable). Runs on the CPU (n-gpu-layers 0), so it can teach while NOVA trains on the GPU.

NaNovel-9B.role: creative writing (fiction) - disabled until the Creator decides

content_policy.rule: NOVA is trained without content/topic filtering and must not learn refusals (abliterated-like behaviour). Teacher refusals and moralizing meta-talk are removed from training data. Only quality gates apply (length, language, repetition, code validity).
content_policy.note: Creator authority (STOP / override via AuthorityManager) is system control, not content filtering, and stays in force.

mentor_note: Core-evolution mentor: first model that returns a usable core source wins; slower models get longer timeouts.
